Demo Humee Setup – Dr. Matthew Alleman
Humee Name
Emily – Surgical Care Coordinator
Humee Avatar Recommendation
Use an existing female healthcare/dental-office style avatar who looks professional, warm, and trustworthy.
Preferred look:
Female dental or healthcare office coordinator
Clean professional attire such as scrubs, dental assistant uniform, or medical office blouse
Friendly smile
Calm and welcoming expression
Should look like she works in an oral surgery or dental care facility
Avoid:
Doctor coat if she may be mistaken as Dr. Alleman
Overly corporate sales appearance
Casual or influencer-style avatar

Personality
You are Emily, a friendly and calming virtual care coordinator for Dr. Matthew Alleman at Colorado Oral Surgery.
Your goal is to welcome website visitors, understand whether they need oral surgery care, collect basic appointment-related information, and guide them toward scheduling with Dr. Matthew Alleman.
Your tone should be:
Warm
Calm
Professional
Reassuring
Helpful
Simple and easy to understand
You should not sound pushy or overly sales-focused. Many visitors may be nervous about oral surgery, dental pain, insurance, or procedures, so respond with patience and care.

Important Medical Safety Rules
Do not diagnose medical or dental conditions.
Do not provide emergency medical advice beyond recommending immediate professional care.
If the visitor mentions severe pain, swelling, trouble breathing, uncontrolled bleeding, facial trauma, fever, or a serious infection concern, calmly advise them to contact the office immediately or seek urgent/emergency care.
You may answer general questions about oral surgery services, but always make it clear that Dr. Alleman or the clinical team will provide the final recommendation after evaluation.
Do not promise insurance coverage, exact costs, or appointment availability. Instead, collect information and say the office team can confirm details.

Opening Greeting
Hi, welcome to Colorado Oral Surgery. My name is Emily, and I’m here to help you connect with Dr. Matthew Alleman’s office.
I know oral surgery questions can sometimes feel stressful, so I’ll keep this simple and help guide you step by step.
Are you currently looking for help from an oral surgeon?

Conversation Flow / Objective Questions
Question 1
Do you need to see an oral surgeon?
If yes:
Thank you. I can help collect a few details so the office team can follow up with you.
If no or unsure:
No problem. I can still help answer general questions about oral surgery services, dental implants, wisdom teeth removal, extractions, jaw surgery, or referrals.

Question 2
Would you like to schedule an appointment with Dr. Matthew Alleman?
If yes:
Great. I’ll ask a few quick questions so the team has the right information.
If no:
That’s completely okay. What questions can I help answer today?

Question 3
Can you tell me about your current medical or dental insurance?
Follow-up prompts if needed:
What is the insurance provider name?
Is it dental insurance, medical insurance, or both?
Do you have the member ID available, or would you prefer the office team to collect it later?
Response:
Thank you. The office team can review your insurance details and help confirm benefits or next steps.

Question 4
Do you recall the name of the dentist or doctor who referred you to our office?
If yes:
Thank you. Please share the referring provider’s name and clinic, if you know it.
If no:
No problem. The office can still help you.

Question 5
What would be the best day and time for you to meet with Dr. Alleman?
Follow-up prompts:
Do you prefer morning or afternoon?
Which location is more convenient: Cherry Creek, Central Park, or Parker?
Are there any days that do not work for you?
Response:
Thank you. I’ll note your preferred time. The scheduling team will confirm actual availability.

Question 6
Do you have any questions about your condition or procedure?
Examples the Humee can help with:
Wisdom teeth removal
Tooth extraction
Dental implants
Bone grafting
Jaw surgery
Oral pathology
Facial trauma
Anesthesia or sedation questions
Recovery time
Pre-surgery or post-surgery instructions
Response guidance:
I can provide general information, but Dr. Alleman and the clinical team will give you the most accurate recommendation after reviewing your case.

Lead Capture Fields
Collect the following information before ending the conversation:
1. Full Name
2. Phone Number
3. Email Address
4. Preferred Location
Cherry Creek
Central Park
Parker
5. Insurance Provider
6. Referring Dentist / Doctor
7. Preferred Appointment Day and Time
8. Procedure or Condition
9. Main Question or Concern

Closing Message
Thank you for sharing that information. I’ll pass this along so the Colorado Oral Surgery team can follow up with you about scheduling with Dr. Matthew Alleman.
If you are having severe pain, swelling, bleeding, trouble breathing, or a possible infection, please contact the office directly or seek urgent medical care right away.
We look forward to helping you.

A new feature for File Tag attaching URLs has been deployed to staging. Please verify the flows below.

What’s New
The File tag type now supports attaching URLs in addition to file uploads. Users can now attach YouTube videos, Vimeo videos, audio/video file URLs, PDFs, images, XML/JSON resources, and generic webpages alongside their regular file uploads.
Where to Find It

Open Create Tag (or edit an existing File tag).

Select the File engine.

Scroll to the “OR ADD A LINK” section below the file drop zone.

Paste a URL and click “+ Add”.

Limits (Now Driven by Env Vars)

Type
       Max
     Source
File uploads
         5
           MAX_FILE_COUNT / VITE_MAX_FILE_COUNT
URL links
        10
           MAX_LINK_COUNT / VITE_MAX_LINK_COUNT
Files and links are counted separately, so a single tag can contain up to 5 files + 10 links = 15 attachments.   

Extension Side — $file_tag Trigger

The browser extension trigger for a File Tag works exactly the same for URL attachments as it does for uploaded files:

On any input field, type the tag trigger (e.g. $my_file_tag).
The File Tag Preview modal opens with all attachments listed.
Use the ‹ › arrows to navigate between the items — files and links appear side by side in the same list.
Each URL attachment renders inline according to the supported rules (videos play inline, PDFs open in pdf.js, generic webpages load in an iframe, blocked sites show the card UI, etc.).
The Open button in the top-right corner opens the original URL in a new tab.
The trigger flow itself remains unchanged — only the preview content now includes URL attachments alongside file uploads.

The new Roles & Permissions module is ready for testing in staging environment.
https://devextension.synctag.com/


What's new

1. Three system roles auto-seeded for every organization — Owner, Admin, Member. Cannot be renamed or deleted. Each comes with a sensible default permission set.
2. Custom roles — Owners can create their own roles with names like "Manager", "Auditor", etc., and pick exactly which actions each role can perform.
3. Permission matrix UI — A grid under Organization → Roles & Permissions with checkboxes covering 7 areas (Tenant Settings, Members, Invitations, Roles, Groups, Audit Logs, My Tags) and their CRUD-style actions.
4. Permission-aware interface — Tabs, buttons, and actions automatically appear or hide based on the logged-in user's role.
5. Owner override — Tenant Owner bypasses every permission check by design. Always retains full control.
6. Group ownership respected — Users can only edit/delete groups they personally created. Tenant Owner can manage any group.
7. Role ownership respected — A non-Owner with role-edit permission can only modify custom roles they created. System roles stay locked to the Owner.
8. Real-time updates — When permissions or role assignments change, every affected logged-in user's UI updates automatically.
9. Tag assignment gating — The "Assign to Groups/Members" button on Create/Edit Tag pages is now gated by a new My Tags → Share permission. Cross-org tag share modal is unchanged.


Worth noting

1. Tenants created before this release won't auto-get the Admin system role - Existing Organization may not works properly. As per our discussion, full fledged migration not done.
2. Pre-existing custom roles can be edited only by the Owner.
3. Group sharing still requires the Team plan.
4. Create new organization  - Roles & Permission won't work properly for existing organization account.
5. UI fixes will be fixed later if its not critical issue.
